_readme: Coverage map for arXiv:2608.14540v1 -- 'A remark on the full support property', Yiran Cheng. Created for GitHub #1184.

THIS IS NOT A TRUST RECORD AND NOT A MINT SURFACE. It is a zero-claim map of the paper's four sections and three main theorem coordinates. formalization.yaml's source remains the Bridgeland 2007 record, and registry/bridgeland2007.json remains the only mint surface. Every status in this file is target.

Update ownership: the owner (Chris Dare) promotes statuses. Agents may add or correct coordinates, but a promotion requires the evidence fields enforced by the validator and formalized additionally requires explicit owner acceptance.

Provenance: metadata and submission history were checked against the arXiv abstract and OAI pages on 2026-09-12. Section titles and statement numbering were read with pdftotext -layout from the pinned v1 PDF. No corpus extraction was used.
